idea-plugin.name: etcd
idea-plugin.description:
Browse and edit an etcd v3 key space from inside the IDE.
  • Browse the key space as a lazily-loaded prefix tree.
  • Read and edit values, with JSON highlighting and Raw / Base64 / Hex views for binary data.
  • Create and delete keys, delete a whole prefix, and export a prefix to JSON.
  • Live updates: keys added or removed by another client appear automatically.
  • Saves are guarded by a compare-and-set on the key's revision, so concurrent edits are never silently overwritten.
Connects over etcd's v3 gRPC-gateway (HTTP/JSON), supporting anonymous access, username/password authentication, TLS with a custom CA, and client certificates (mTLS). The plugin bundles no third-party libraries.
